records.text: Owens denied ever having a MySpace account and said she had a college Twitter account she wished she could access.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Family and friends. They also found that I had a Twitter account in college that I've regularly said I wish I could get into because it's so funny. What is wrong with this account? I'm going like, what is wrong? And then that's when I was like, okay, now they're getting crazy. They said that I had a, um, what's it called, a MySpace. I've never in my life had a MySpace account. This is not something you can just make up. This is, MySpace was in middle school. You can't pretend someone had a MySpace account. There would be so much data out there—

records.text: Owens said the MySpace account falsely purported to be hers was archived on August 5, 2025.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The MySpace account that they're purporting as mine, that is not mine, look at the date and when they archived it. ... August 5th, 2025.

records.text: Owens said a fake MySpace account for her was archived August 4.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Also on August 4th, a fake MySpace account is archived for me. We added that.
